q1: SELECT O1.SEAT_ID FROM CINEMA O1 WHERE O1.FREE = 1 AND ((SELECT FREE FROM CINEMA O2 WHERE O2.SEAT_ID = O1.SEAT_ID - 1) = 1 OR (SELECT FREE FROM CINEMA O2 WHERE O2.SEAT_ID = O1.SEAT_ID + 1) = 1)
q2: SELECT DISTINCT B.SEAT_ID FROM CINEMA A LEFT JOIN CINEMA B ON ABS(A.SEAT_ID - B.SEAT_ID) = 1 WHERE A.FREE = 1 AND B.FREE = 1

explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not semantically equivalent because Q1 checks for adjacent free seats in either direction (left or right) for each seat, while Q2 checks for at least one free seat on either side of each free seat.
counterexample_dsp: A cinema with three seats, where the middle seat is free, and the seats on either side are occupied. Q1 will return the middle seat, while Q2 will not return any seat.
